TikReader modifications in raindrop-fx.js:
- Request an alpha WebGL2 context; clear output to transparent and skip background draw.
- Replace final water shading with translucent highlights and shadows.
- Grow the instance buffer to fit the initial seeded droplets.
The simulation and droplet normal-map rendering remain Raindrop FX.
Wrapper owns the animation clock and uses actual elapsed time.
- Preserve correct alpha with separate RGB/alpha blending; amplify the water normal map for glass highlights.

original.js: unmodified upstream bundle, SHA256 cbe3df720636639d5bec28855bac5cc5395f0593f6b731c9fad98ab1de68100b.
